title: [AINews] TypeSafe/Jev at >$100M ARR, $7.5B valuation 3 weeks after launch
summary: As you can see in the AINews X recap section below, everyone on earth has cloned the Jev API, but only one company can ever create the category. TypeSafe announced their “ Series AI ” and Sequoia “ leaked ” that they crossed 100M ARR in their first week.
takeaways: Multi-Agent Orchestration and Coding Tools Claude Managed Agents dynamic workflows (public beta) : A lead agent writes a phased plan, fans it out to up to 1,000 agents per run, then merges the results.
AI Twitter Recap Decision Models Become a Product Category The pattern : Several vendors shipped “decision” models on the same day.
OpenAI Decisions API : Three request types: probability that a condition is true, pick from a list, or score against levels.
